sourceText: User asked to start execution on automatic processing so story DONE data can enter playbook candidate consumption instead of remaining only as settlement/proposable seeds.
normalizedOutcome: After this story, DONE story experience can be automatically ingested into inert candidate playbooks through a digest-bound command and non-blocking post-DONE hook, while active playbook activation remains evidence-gated.
acceptanceClaim: A fresh DONE/done-experience seed can produce candidatePlaybooks > 0 without writing helped outcomes or auto-activation rows, and status/runtime verification shows candidates are inert until evidence activation.
